title: [Renseikai] Lesson Report under Lesson – SF Group lesson – Initial shared values – Copied to every student detail
description: AC 01.1 / AC 01.4 — CRUD and Component — SF save copies all three shared values to every student detail.
preconditions:
- Actor: HQ or CM Staff logged in to Salesforce.
- Group lesson LR-57816-SF-01 has Aiko Tanaka and Haruto Sato; report status = Draft.
- content_v1 = Linear equations: solving two variables; announcement_v1 = Bring calculator on 2026-08-05; homework_v1 = Workbook pp. 20-21.
steps_actions:
1. 1. Open Lesson LR-57816-SF-01 and select Report.
2. 2. Enter and save all three shared values.
3. 3. Open the Student Lesson Allocation record for Aiko Tanaka and Haruto Sato in Salesforce. Select Report History and locate the target lesson in the Lesson Report Details table.

steps_data:

2. 2. content_v1; announcement_v1; homework_v1.
